text: They'd fill that naked disguise and sell the sea's imagination, cultivation. It was in vain, those beards were grown. Imagination, annihilation. Now each jet soldier has a mattress on his own. They say our cars are crowded, but they're not, for I have proof. If you look close, you'll find there's lots of room upon the roof. A fat girl once got on a car when all the seats were gone.
